steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Systematic fault finding follows a logical sequence: observe symptoms, identify the section at fault, locate the faulty component, then repair and test. | Key Fact: The half-split method tests at the midpoint of a signal path, halving the suspect area with each measurement. | Key Fact: An open circuit breaks the current path; symptoms include zero current flow and full supply voltage across the break. | Key Fact: A short circuit provides a zero-resistance path; symptoms include excessive current, blown fuses and overheating.
